name.local: 台灣天使俱樂部（台灣全球天使投資俱樂部）

aka: 台灣全球天使投資俱樂部

strategy.thesis: Angel network co-founded in early 2022 by IC Jan (詹益鑑) and Pai-Sheng Huang (黃沛聲) that pools Taiwan- and Silicon-Valley-based angel investors and tech executives into US LLC/SPV structures to co-invest in startups; medical technology is named first among its three core investment themes (medical technology, automation, smart IoT), explicitly framed around Taiwan's aging-population opportunity ('Aging' is one of its stated '4 A' priorities).

summary.en: Taiwan-Silicon Valley angel network (founded 2022) that invests via US SPVs, naming medical technology as its lead sector alongside automation and smart IoT, with an explicit thesis around aging-population healthcare needs.
summary.local: 台灣天使俱樂部（TGA）成立於2022年初，由詹益鑑與黃沛聲共同創辦，結合台灣與矽谷兩地天使投資人及科技高管，透過美國SPV共同投資新創，投資主軸包括醫療科技、自動化方案與智慧物聯網，並以高齡化社會需求為核心投資邏輯之一。

sources.title: 台灣天使俱樂部 / 台灣全球天使投資俱樂部
sources.supports: founding year, founders, investment focus (medical technology, automation, smart IoT)
sources.quote: 聚集太平洋兩岸之天使投資人、科技高管與創業家，結合台灣的研發經驗與環境，共同投資矽谷新創，聚焦醫療科技、自動化方案、智慧物聯網

sources.title: 專訪 TGA 創辦人詹益鑑：最好的新創投資策略，其實就是幫台灣「更好出海」！
sources.supports: '4 A' investment thesis including Aging, structure via US LLC/SPV, cumulative investment since 2022
sources.quote: TGA的投資策略圍繞著「四個A」：迎接高齡化商機（Aging）、透過自動化因應缺工需求（Automation）、聚焦效率提升的關鍵技術人工智慧（Artificial Intelligence），以及鎖定美國市場（America）

verification_notes: Core facts (founders, founding date, sector focus) come from two independent reputable secondary sources (GlobalBio/環球生技月刊 and INSIDE) rather than a directly-fetched official filing; official site URL confirmed to exist via search but not deep-fetched. A cumulative investment figure of over NT$600M since 2022 was reported by INSIDE but not independently corroborated, so it is omitted from structured fields.

name.local: 財團法人永齡健康基金會

strategy.thesis: Personal charitable foundation of Foxconn founder Terry Gou (郭台銘), established in 2000, that deploys both philanthropic and direct strategic-investment capital into cancer treatment, prevention, and precision diagnostics; runs the H.Spectrum+ biomedical startup accelerator connecting founders to venture capital and medical investment funds, and separately backed a NT$5.03 billion strategic private placement into oncology biosimilar/CDMO company TaiKang Biotech (台康生技) in 2021, becoming its largest shareholder.

lifesci.science_platform_notes: Runs H.Spectrum+ ('Health Golden Phoenix') biomedical accelerator with Foxconn, and co-established the Yongzhen Health Medical Building cancer center with National Taiwan University Hospital.

summary.en: Terry Gou's family healthcare foundation (est. 2000) that runs the H.Spectrum+ biomedical accelerator and has made large direct strategic investments in oncology biotech, including a reported NT$5.03B private placement into TaiKang Biotech in 2021 that made Gou its largest shareholder.
summary.local: 由鴻海創辦人郭台銘於2000年成立的家族健康基金會，主辦H.Spectrum+生醫加速器，並直接投入大額策略性投資於腫瘤生技公司，2021年以逾新台幣50億元參與台康生技私募案，成為最大股東。

sources.title: 財團法人永齡健康基金會
sources.supports: founding year, founder, mission, sector focus, H.Spectrum+ accelerator
sources.quote: 財團法人永齡健康基金會成立於2000年11月29日... 支持智慧醫療、精準檢測與偵測、生技及醫材新創加速

sources.title: 【郭董生技大投資】郭台銘豪砸50億元 當乳癌新藥廠台康生技最大股東
sources.supports: NT$5.03B TaiKang Biotech investment amount, year, stake, rationale tied to Gou's health-focused giving
sources.quote: 郭台銘旗下兆佳公司以每股91.5元參與台康生技私募案，總金額約新台幣50.32億元，取得約5,500萬股，成為台康生技最大股東

verification_notes: The NT$5.03B TaiKang Biotech investment was executed through Gou's personal investment vehicle (兆佳公司) rather than the Foundation entity itself, per Mirror Media; multiple secondary sources describe this as part of Gou's broader personal-plus-Foundation health investment strategy (combined ~NT$2B+ reported cumulatively over a decade). Foundation is classified here as family-office given it is a single-family (Gou family) vehicle actively deploying capital into biomedical ventures, with venture-philanthropy and accelerator as secondary characteristics.

strategy.thesis: Generalist angel investment group active since September 2012 with 80+ member executives/entrepreneurs; Biotech & CleanTech is one of five named investment verticals (alongside Cultural Creativity, Mobile & Commerce, Software & Services, and Technology & Hardware), with biotech firm LumiSTAR (昱星生技) among its disclosed portfolio companies, giving it a verifiable but secondary biomedical nexus.

summary.en: Taipei-based angel investor group (founded 2012, 80+ members) that meets monthly to vet startups; Biotech & CleanTech is one of its five stated focus sectors, with portfolio company LumiSTAR (昱星生技) as its biomedical proof point.
summary.local: 台安傑天使投資成立於2012年9月，為台北在地天使投資人組織，成員逾80位企業高管與創業者，每月共同審議新創投資案，投資五大領域之一為「生技醫療與潔淨科技」，投資組合中包含生技公司昱星生技。

strategy.thesis: Asia's largest angel-investor community by claimed member count (~500 members, founded 2016), using a cash-flow-focused value-investing screen; healthcare — explicitly including senior/elder wellness ('銀髮族健康樂齡') — is named as one of its three core investment pillars alongside consumer staples and green energy.

summary.en: Taiwan's largest self-described angel investment club (~500 members, founded 2016), with healthcare and senior/elder wellness named as one of three core investment pillars alongside consumer staples and green energy.
summary.local: MBC天使俱樂部創立於2016年，號稱亞洲規模最大的天使投資社群，會員近500人，投資領域以民生消費類、綠能領域與醫療領域（含銀髮族健康樂齡）為三大主軸。

sources.quote: MBC天使俱樂部創立於2016年，是亞洲人數規模最大的天使投資社群...投資領域以現金流穩定、看得到、摸得到的民生消費類、綠能領域、醫療領域為主軸...涵蓋食、衣、住、行、育、樂，以及醫療、銀髮族健康樂齡、綠色能源以及ESG概念等產業

verification_notes: Healthcare is one of three named generalist verticals (alongside consumer goods and green energy), not the club's sole focus; no specific biotech/medtech portfolio company could be verified within the research budget for this slice, so notable_investments is omitted rather than guessed.

aka: 安發天使投資股份有限公司

strategy.thesis: Generalist early-stage angel-investment platform blending angel capital with a fund vehicle (AVA Angel Fund I) to fill a gap in Taiwan's early-stage market; healthcare is named as one of its core sectors, with portfolio company Primo building a cross-disciplinary precision/digital-medicine model.

summary.en: Taipei angel-investment platform founded in 2020 that combines angel capital with a fund structure (AVA Angel Fund I); healthcare/precision medicine is one of its named verticals, and portfolio company Primo is building a cross-disciplinary precision/digital-medicine model.
summary.local: 2020年成立的台北天使投資平台，結合天使投資與基金模式（AVA Angel Fund I），醫療為其命名投資領域之一，投資組合包含精準醫療新創Primo。

name.en: Ruentex Group / Yin Yen-liang Family Biotech Investments
name.local: 潤泰集團／尹衍樑家族生技投資

strategy.thesis: Personal/family capital of the late Ruentex Group chairman Yin Yen-liang (尹衍樑), dubbed Taiwan's 'biotech investment godfather' (生技投資教父) for deploying over NT$4 billion across roughly a decade into about ten new-drug-development companies — recruiting overseas-Chinese ('sea turtle') scientist-entrepreneurs and providing long-horizon patient capital. Portfolio includes OBI Pharma (浩鼎) and TaiMed Biologics (中裕新藥).

lifesci.science_platform_notes: No in-house lab; the strategy centers on recruiting prominent overseas-Chinese drug-development scientists (e.g. OBI Pharma's Chang Nien-tzu, TaiMed's David Ho) and backing their ventures with large, patient capital over 10+ year horizons.

people.name: Yin Yen-liang (尹衍樑)
people.background: Ruentex Group conglomerate chairman; profiled in Taiwanese business press as the country's 'biotech investment godfather'

people.name: Yin Chung-en (尹崇恩)

people.background: Daughter of Yin Yen-liang; partner at Yungan CPA firm; also director at Ruentex Materials, Ruentex Security and Ruentex Leasing

summary.en: The personal/family biotech investment activity of the late Ruentex Group chairman Yin Yen-liang, who deployed over NT$4 billion across roughly a decade into about ten new-drug-development ventures (including OBI Pharma and TaiMed Biologics), earning him the nickname 'Taiwan's biotech investment godfather'; his daughter Yin Chung-en continues family involvement as a TaiMed Biologics board director.
summary.local: 已故潤泰集團總裁尹衍樑十年來以個人及集團資金砸下逾新台幣40億元，投資約十家新藥研發公司（含浩鼎、中裕新藥），被封為「台灣生技投資教父」；其女尹崇恩現任台康生技獨立董事，家族持續參與生技版圖。

name.local: 永豐餘生技（何壽川家族）

aka: 永豐餘生技股份有限公司

strategy.thesis: Dedicated biomedical strategic-investment arm of the family-controlled YFY (永豐餘) conglomerate, led by chairman Ho Shou-chuan (何壽川); for roughly three decades has selectively backed potential companies across high-end medical devices, biopharma, and high-end diagnostics, providing capital plus management support toward eventual listing. Co-invested in the founding round of TaiMed Biologics (中裕新藥, then Sunrise Biotech 宇昌生技) alongside Ruentex and Uni-President.

people.name: Ho Shou-chuan (何壽川)
people.background: Family patriarch of the YFY (永豐餘) conglomerate; profiled in Taiwanese business press as one of three 'biotech investment godfathers'

summary.en: The dedicated biomedical investment arm of the family-controlled YFY conglomerate (paper, packaging, finance), led by chairman Ho Shou-chuan; over roughly 30 years it has made strategic investments across high-end medical devices, biopharma and diagnostics, including a founding-round stake in TaiMed Biologics.
summary.local: 永豐餘集團（何壽川家族）旗下的生醫策略投資事業，近30年來聚焦高階醫材、生技製藥、高階診斷三大面向，並曾參與中裕新藥（前身宇昌生技）創立時期的投資。
